baseline.led_class: SK9822 / APA102-class RGB; exact vendor/part unknown
baseline.camera: IMX415 rolling shutter; f/2; fixed focus ~0.6m; FOV82x52; fixed IR-cut

requirements.requirement: ≥100 lx added at 0.15 m on axis; CV distance from M1
requirements.evidence: 0.15m axis-patch and cone sensitivity solves; real flux and CV not known
requirements.requirement_zh: 0.15m轴上新增≥100lx；暗室CV工作距离由M1确定。
requirements.evidence_zh: 已补0.15m轴心小区与光锥条件化求解；真实光量与CV尚未确定。

requirements.requirement: No full-off animation in A; floor level from M1
requirements.evidence: A waveform baseline implemented; hardware PWM and slew conflict unresolved
requirements.requirement_zh: A模式动画不能全灭；最低可用亮度由M1确定。
requirements.evidence_zh: A底光波形已实现；真实PWM及转动灭灯冲突待解决。

requirements.requirement: Camera exposure/gain minus calibrated ring contribution; no sampling blink; awake only
requirements.evidence: Algorithm contract and simulator-only ambient input; no calibrated detector
requirements.requirement_zh: 相机曝光/增益经标定后扣除环灯贡献；不能灭灯采样；只在唤醒时运行。
requirements.evidence_zh: 已定义标定流程与手动场景；未接入真实相机自动判断。

requirements.requirement: 14 state families; white only; red reserved for camera live
requirements.evidence: Proposed state simulator covers all listed states, not approved UX
requirements.requirement_zh: 覆盖全部14类状态；正常白色，红色保留给camera live。
requirements.evidence_zh: 模拟器覆盖全部状态；动画设计为提案，非已批准UX。

requirements.requirement: Captured colour/level change within M5 tolerance
requirements.evidence: Red capture policy shown; no RGB spectral/image simulation or passing claim
requirements.requirement_zh: 红色拍摄指示引起的画面颜色/亮度变化应满足M5容差。
requirements.evidence_zh: 标出红色拍摄策略；没有RGB光谱、真实图像或通过结论。

requirements.requirement: ≤3 flashes/s policy; smooth fades; depth/time from M3/M4
requirements.evidence: Proposed slow cadences and transitions; no perceptual/WCAG certification
requirements.requirement_zh: 每秒最多3次闪烁；平顺渐变；调制深度与过渡时长由M3/M4确定。
requirements.evidence_zh: 采用慢节奏与平滑渐变提案；无舒适性或WCAG认证结论。

requirements.requirement: No visible bands over actual exposure range; vendor PWM/global-brightness disclosure
requirements.evidence: Ideal PWM calculator retained; actual second-PWM and sensor timing unknown
requirements.requirement_zh: 实际曝光范围内无可见条纹；供应商说明通道PWM与全局亮度实现。
requirements.evidence_zh: 保留理想PWM计算；真实双PWM和传感器逐行时序仍未知。

requirements.requirement: Frame brightness within M3 limit or provide ring level to image processor
requirements.evidence: Exported per-frame commands as integration interface; AE not modeled
requirements.requirement_zh: 帧间亮度变化在M3容差内，或向图像处理器前馈环灯亮度。
requirements.evidence_zh: 导出逐时平均指令作为前馈接口参考；未建立AE闭环。

requirements.requirement: Contrast loss through Ø14 aperture within M7 tolerance
requirements.evidence: Hole modeled; no lens/baffle/contrast solve; opening flux is not flare
requirements.requirement_zh: 通过Ø14孔的杂散光不得导致超过M7容差的对比度损失。
requirements.evidence_zh: 已建开孔；无真实镜头/遮光结构和对比度求解。

requirements.requirement: ≤±20%; no hotspots/dark sectors; measured material from M2
requirements.evidence: Conditional sampled mean-relative deviation reported; full window/views unverified
requirements.requirement_zh: 窗口均匀性≤±20%；无热点或暗区；材料由M2实测确定。
requirements.evidence_zh: 报告暂定均值参考下的采样偏差；全窗口、视角和收敛仍待验证。

requirements.evidence: Electrical budget calculations and calibrated-input estimator; real current/thermal pending
requirements.requirement_zh: 持续200mA，短时500mA，绝不超过500mA；整球预算约7W。
requirements.evidence_zh: 已加入电流预算和需标定输入的估算；真实电流与热尚待测。

measurements: CV照度底线、工作距离及A/B边界

RGB spectra, camera spectral response, colour/level tolerances
